## Abderrahmane Wardi

I am a Professor of Industrial Engineering Sciences and a PhD candidate working in the field of biomedical engineering.

My academic activities combine **teaching**, **scientific research**, **embedded systems**, **biomedical signal processing**, and **artificial intelligence**.

## Academic Interests

My main academic and research interests include:

- Biomedical Engineering
- ECG Signal Processing
- TinyML
- Embedded Artificial Intelligence
- Embedded Systems
- Biomedical Instrumentation
- Internet of Things
- Engineering Education

## Teaching

My teaching activities focus on electrical engineering, industrial engineering sciences, instrumentation, signal acquisition, signal processing, and embedded systems.

## Research

My doctoral research focuses on intelligent biomedical systems, particularly the processing and classification of ECG signals using lightweight artificial intelligence models suitable for embedded devices.

## Academic Mission

My objective is to combine teaching, research, and engineering practice to develop accessible and efficient solutions in biomedical engineering and intelligent embedded systems.
